units.source_text: 笔迹与书法都很出色，丝毫不劣于京中贵族女子。

en.t: Her handwriting and calligraphy were both excellent, in no way inferior to those of noble ladies in the capital.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了这明石姬的书柬，想起京中的情况来，觉得和此人通信颇有兴趣。

en.t: After Prince Genji read this letter from the Lady of Akashi, he was reminded of life in the capital and found it quite interesting to correspond with her.

units.source_text: 但往还太勤，深恐外人注目，散布流言。

en.t: But if their letters went back and forth too often, he greatly feared that outsiders would notice and spread rumors.

units.source_text: 于是隔两三天通信一次。

en.t: So they exchanged letters once every two or three days.

units.source_text: 例如寂寞无聊的黄昏，多愁多感的黎明，便借口作书。

en.t: For example, on lonely, idle evenings or at dawn when his feelings were especially tender and sorrowful, he would use them as excuses to write.

units.source_text: 或者推量女的亦有同感的时候，寄信慰问。

en.t: Or, imagining that she might be feeling the same way, he would send a letter to comfort her.

units.source_text: 明石姬每次回信，都不无适当之语。

en.t: Whenever the Lady of Akashi replied, her letters always contained words that were fitting and well chosen.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想象这女子的风韵娴雅的品质，觉得不见一面不甘罢休。

en.t: Prince Genji imagined the graceful elegance of this woman and felt he could not rest without meeting her once.

units.source_text: 然而良清每次说起这女子，总表示“此人属我”的神情，令人不快。

en.t: Yet whenever Yoshikiyo spoke of her, he always wore an expression as if to say, This woman belongs to me, which was unpleasant.

units.source_text: 况且他已经苦心追求了多年，今我当面攫取，使他失望，又觉对他不起。

en.t: Besides, he had pursued her with great effort for many years, and Genji felt it would be unfair to snatch her away before his eyes and leave him disappointed.

units.source_text: 左思右想，最好对方主动，移尊就教，我不得已而接受，如此最为妥当。

en.t: After thinking it over from every angle, he decided the most proper course would be for her to take the initiative and come to him, leaving him no choice but to accept.

units.source_text: 然而那女的比故作姿态的贵族女子更为高傲，决不肯毛遂自荐，教人奈何不得。

en.t: But she was even prouder than noble ladies who deliberately put on airs, and she would never present herself uninvited, leaving him at a loss.

units.source_text: 于是双方对垒，竞赛耐性，如此因循度日。

en.t: Thus the two sides faced each other off, competing in patience, and let the days drift by in this way.
